economy.summary: On her campaign site she says she is dedicated to bringing home state dollars to invest in communities and neighborhoods, and that she wants every Pennsylvanian to be able to work and live a quality day-to-day life in economically trying times.
economy.short: Says she brings home state dollars to invest in communities.

taxes.summary: Her campaign platform lists requiring gas drillers to pay a fair tax among her environment priorities.
taxes.short: Supports requiring gas drillers to pay a fair tax.

abortion.summary: Her campaign platform says she will fight for reproductive access and choice, and she states a commitment to the protection of Roe in Pennsylvania.
abortion.short: Says she will fight for reproductive access and choice.

education.summary: Her campaign platform calls to fully and fairly fund public schools, fix crumbling school infrastructure, reform charter schools, support and pay teachers, make college affordable, and reduce student debt.
education.short: Supports funding public schools, reforming charters, affordable college.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign site lists support for affordable healthcare and for paid family and medical leave among her stated positions.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable healthcare and paid family and medical leave.

energy.summary: Her campaign platform calls to move Pennsylvania to renewable energy, protect clean drinking water, hold corporate polluters accountable, and protect children from lead and other toxins.
energy.short: Supports renewable energy, clean water, holding polluters accountable.

guns.summary: Her campaign platform calls to ban assault weapons and bump stocks, enact a red flag law, support thorough background checks, and destroy guns previously used in crimes.
guns.short: Supports banning assault weapons, red flag law, background checks.
